entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • OverrideHtmlAssetPlaceholders ignores the fingerprint placeholder on non-JavaScript assets, so a hard-fingerprinted stylesheet 404s after publish #57329
  • CA1508 runs for an hour or more on a method with recursive local functions called from nested loops #57327
  • Support version ranges in tool config.json files #57325
  • [Known Build Error] ProcessLifecycleTests intermittently fail on Linux Helix (signal marker / timing) #57321
  • ReadyToRun composite: unrooted inputs are not tracked as _CreateR2RImages inputs, so changes to them publish stale components #57320
  • dotnet reference add refuses a project whose TargetFramework is an alias (parses the alias text, not TargetFrameworkMoniker) #57317
  • [CI triage] Lifecycle SIGTERM test does not observe the forwarded marker on Linux #57316

Closed

  • Using Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Publish differs per platform #16469
